<!--
NARRATIVE REPORT SCAFFOLD (RNAseq-Templates).

This is a STARTER for a project-specific, conclusion-led narrative report —
the layer that sits above the generic technical `RNAseq_report.html`. Read
references/NARRATIVE_REPORT.md before writing prose. Contract highlights:

  - Every headline number is read from saved run outputs at render time via
    the citers (sv/gl/gp/gnes/ora_terms). NEVER hand-type a value.
  - Headings are conclusions, not topic labels ("Combo vs NIR is a structural
    null", not "DEG results").
  - One bio-box per major section: what it means, in plain language.
  - Figures come ONLY from the run-bundle PDFs via show_pdf() — the single
    source of truth. Never embed screenshots or hand-copied images.
  - Before curating into results/reports/, the rendered HTML MUST pass
    validate_narrative_report().

Whole-line HTML comments (like this block) are scaffold guidance and do not
render. Delete a section's guidance once the prose is written; delete any
section that is not applicable rather than leaving a stub.
-->

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Locate the shared template library. Set RNASEQ_LIB_DIR, or fall back to the
# RNAseq-Templates repo found by walking up from the project.
lib_dir <- Sys.getenv("RNASEQ_LIB_DIR", unset = NA)
if (is.na(lib_dir) || !dir.exists(lib_dir)) {
  stop("Set RNASEQ_LIB_DIR to the RNAseq_lib directory of RNAseq-Templates.")
}
source(file.path(lib_dir, "narrative_utils.R"))

run_dir <- file.path(params$project_root, "analysis", "runs", params$run_id)
# Bring sv/gl/gp/gnes/ora_terms/show_pdf into scope for all chunks.
list2env(make_report_citers(run_dir), envir = globalenv())
show_table <- function(df, caption = NULL) {
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(cat("_（无记录）_\n"))
  knitr::kable(df, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
.summary-box { background:#eef4f7; border-left:5px solid #2e6f8e; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:6px; margin:1em 0; }
.caution-box { background:#fff6e5; border-left:5px solid #c07f2a; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:6px; margin:1em 0; }
.bio-box { background:#eef7ee; border-left:5px solid #2e8b57; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:6px; margin:1em 0; }
.bio-tag { color:#2e8b57; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:1px; }
```
